title: Feature: Supply Cache
rationale: PM prompt: Add a “Supply Cache” at the Basic Toolmaking research handoff that trades 5 food for 20 wood instantly, has a highly visible pulsing card and a 120-second cooldown, includes an Elder line directing the player back to Research, and uses a wooden supply-crate emblem.

feature_plugin.title: Supply Cache
feature_plugin.visual_prompt: Painted Celtic storybook game emblem, a neat stack of cut timber logs with visible round log ends and bark, tied with rope, beside an open wooden crate and a small grain sack, warm ochre and forest green, bold readable silhouette, plain cream background, no text.
feature_plugin.advisor_intro: Short of timber, Chief? Trade a little food at the Supply Cache, then carry on with your research.
